n9f9922647ca.s: RTI Online, a portal of the Department of Personnel and Training, is used to file RTI applications and appeals before:
n9f9922647ca.x: RTI Online is the DoPT portal for filing RTI applications and appeals to central public authorities.

nb41c94c49df.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: CPGRAMS – Ministry of Commerce and Industry
GeM – Ministry of Commerce and Industry
nb41c94c49df.x: GeM belongs to the Ministry of Commerce and Industry. UMANG is under MeitY, e-Office is a MeitY-NIC platform and CPGRAMS is associated with DARPG.

n869c61fb444.s: GIMS, released as the Sandes app for secure government communication, stands for:
n869c61fb444.x: GIMS is the Government Instant Messaging System, India's in-house secure messaging alternative built by NIC and released as the Sandes app.

n922b3f6e2bb.s: The vision of the National e-Governance Plan was to make all government services accessible to the common man in his locality through:
n922b3f6e2bb.x: NeGP aimed to make government services accessible locally through common service delivery outlets, with transparency, reliability, efficiency and affordable cost.

n226c90b82ab.s: GeM, the online public procurement portal launched in 2016, belongs to which ministry?
o: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
n226c90b82ab.x: GeM is the online public procurement portal of the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, launched in 2016.

nda614981ca9.s: ABHA under the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission is a:
nda614981ca9.x: ABHA is the 14-digit health ID under ABDM; facility and practitioner registries are separate ABDM components.

n71cf1b62413.s:
Assertion (A): ABDM is designed as a national interoperable digital health ecosystem.
Reason (R): Its framework includes health IDs, registries of facilities and practitioners, and interoperable linked health records.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n71cf1b62413.x: Both are true, and the combination of identity, registries and interoperable records explains ABDM's ecosystem-wide design.

n4b6a5b130de.s: PRAGATI, launched on 25 March 2015 for proactive governance, grievance handling and project monitoring, is a platform of the:
o: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
n4b6a5b130de.x: PRAGATI (Pro-Active Governance And Timely Implementation) is associated with the PMO and deals with grievances and project monitoring.

n1cd19e58ad9.s: The 'State Collaboration Initiatives' scheme, which funds replication of award-winning e-governance initiatives, is administered by:
n1cd19e58ad9.x: State Collaboration Initiatives is a DARPG scheme, revised in 2015-16, funding replication of PM-awarded and National e-Governance-awarded initiatives.

n0bfc9062b16.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: e-Pathshala – Department of Pension and Pensioners' Welfare
DIKSHA – NCERT and Ministry of Education
SWAYAM – Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
PM eVIDYA – Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
n0bfc9062b16.x: DIKSHA is associated with NCERT and the Ministry of Education; the other pairs assign unrelated ministries.

n411dbeeca6e.s: The first e-Cabinet in India was established in which State?
n411dbeeca6e.x: Himachal Pradesh was the first State in India to establish an e-Cabinet.

o: 16-digit number encoding the State of residence
12-digit random number that is free and lifelong
ndc3cf7d2ad9.x: Aadhaar is a free, lifelong, 12-digit random number; it does not encode caste, religion or geography.

n3b50672f791.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: e-RUPI – Permanent cash transfer account with no specified purpose
UPI Lite – Large-value payments needing a UPI PIN every time
BHIM – NPCI's UPI app launched on 30 December 2016
Bharat QR – QR code restricted to one card network
n3b50672f791.x: BHIM is NPCI's UPI app launched on 30 December 2016. e-RUPI is a one-time purpose-specific voucher, UPI Lite is for small payments without a PIN, and Bharat QR is interoperable.

nc7a5e315780.s: The nodal responsibility for digital payments presently rests with the:
o: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance
nc7a5e315780.x: Digital payments now come under the Department of Financial Services, which also gives the Digital Payments Awards; earlier MeitY was the nodal department.

n92350eb0797.s: What share of PMJDY accounts was reported to be held by women?
n92350eb0797.x: More than half of PMJDY accounts were reported to be held by women.

n0858cbcff18.s: Which was the first country in Europe to accept UPI?
n0858cbcff18.x: France was the first country in Europe to accept UPI.

n219f307c88e.s: BharatNet has been laid by which group of Central Public Sector Undertakings?
n219f307c88e.x: BharatNet has been laid by the CPSUs BSNL, RailTel and Power Grid Corporation of India Limited (PGCIL).

nd5fd225ead6.s: Which of the following is NOT one of the five characteristics of cloud computing identified under MeghRaj?
nd5fd225ead6.x: The five characteristics are on-demand self-service, ubiquitous network access, metered use, elasticity and resource pooling; dedicated hardware per user is not one of them.

n20c482bb711.s: PM-WANI, launched in December 2020 with 3.15 lakh hotspots reported, is a:
n20c482bb711.x: PM-WANI is a public Wi-Fi initiative launched in December 2020, with 3.15 lakh hotspots reported.

n0d543e37953.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Vidya Vahini – Computer education in schools
e-Pathshala – Computer labs and ICT learning
n0d543e37953.x: Vidya Vahini was a school project focused on computer education. ICT@Schools concerned computer labs, NDLM digital literacy, and e-Pathshala digital educational resources.

ncb80361e3d0.s: Under MeeSeva, which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
ncb80361e3d0.x: The EDS Department prints MeeSeva certificates, while the Education Department issues migration certificates to passed candidates.

n742b27f0005.s: CARD in Andhra Pradesh is concerned with:
o: Networking of district headquarters and mandals
n742b27f0005.x: CARD is the Registration Department's computer-aided registration system for property documents.

n3cad23b0248.s: Registration Service Kendras in Andhra Pradesh are modelled on the:
n3cad23b0248.x: RSKs provide property-registration services on the Passport Seva Kendra model, while statutory powers remain with the Sub-Registrar Offices.

n37c0f4c13bb.s: The Andhra Pradesh Cyber Security Policy, aimed at a secure cyber ecosystem for citizens, businesses and government, was formulated in:
n37c0f4c13bb.x: The AP Cyber Security Policy was formulated in 2017 to establish a secure cyber ecosystem for citizens, businesses and government.

n2c656847531.s: Under the April 2023 IT Rules amendment, an intermediary could lose safe harbour if content on Central Government business was flagged as fake by:
n2c656847531.x: The April 2023 amendment provided for loss of safe harbour where content concerning Central Government business was flagged as fake by the PIB Fact Check Unit.

n7975da7e29c.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: BNS Section 78 – Stalking, including monitoring electronic communication
n7975da7e29c.x: BNS Section 78 covers stalking, including monitoring electronic communication. Section 66E of the IT Act concerns privacy violation and Section 67 obscene material.

o: Provide advanced coding training to urban professionals
Provide financial literacy to adults under ULLAS
Make one person in every rural family digitally literate
n7862392afe6.x: PMGDISHA promotes rural digital literacy with the aim of one digitally literate person in every family; it was launched by the Prime Minister at Gandhinagar.

nc1d2ea98d7e.s: Pegasus, a zero-click spyware, is associated with:
o: The NSA of the United States
nc1d2ea98d7e.x: Pegasus is state-grade zero-click spyware associated with Israel's NSO Group that can exploit zero-days without user interaction.

n55e1d69ecec.s: Mirai, known for massive DDoS attacks using hijacked IoT devices, is a:
n55e1d69ecec.x: Mirai is a botnet that hijacked IoT devices and used them to launch large-scale DDoS attacks.

nd5edaa61f46.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Spam – Flooding an inbox to crash it
E-mail bombing – Malicious database code entered through input fields
Man-in-the-middle – Secretly intercepting communication between two parties
nd5edaa61f46.x: Man-in-the-middle means secretly intercepting or altering communication between two parties. Spam is unsolicited bulk mail, e-mail bombing floods an inbox, and SQL injection inserts malicious database code.

o: Using a VPN to conceal a victim's browsing history
Stealing a person's identity to obtain a duplicate SIM
Trafficking people and forcing them to conduct cyber fraud
Selling stolen data through encrypted e-mail
n9f4ce4856bb.x: Cyber slavery involves trafficking victims and coercing them to run cyber-fraud schemes, often from scam centres.

n500ae8b1e82.s: Hashing is best described as a:
o: One-way process producing a fixed-length digest
Method of sharing one secret key with all users
Process using only the sender's private key to sign
n500ae8b1e82.x: Hashing is one-way and produces a fixed-length digest; even a small input change alters the hash (e.g. SHA-256).

n5b0be16e065.s: Under the Public Key Infrastructure framework, Digital Signature Certificates are issued by:
o: Certifying Authorities licensed by the Controller of Certifying Authorities
n5b0be16e065.x: Digital Signature Certificates are issued by Certifying Authorities licensed by the Controller of Certifying Authorities.

n1070ae5fe28.s: Which of the following pairs relating to the IT Act, 2000 is correctly matched?
o: Section 4 – Legal recognition of electronic signatures
Section 66F – Legal recognition of electronic records
Section 43A – Compensation for failure to protect sensitive personal data
n1070ae5fe28.x: Section 43A concerns compensation for failure to protect sensitive personal data. Section 4 covers electronic records, Section 5 electronic signatures and Section 66F cyber terrorism.

nee4a8b54831.s: Cyber Surakshit Bharat, launched in 2018, primarily trained:
nee4a8b54831.x: Cyber Surakshit Bharat, associated with MeitY and launched in 2018, focused on training Chief Information Security Officers.

n0a4f0f4d386.s: After Shreya Singhal v. Union of India (2015), 'actual knowledge' under Section 79 of the IT Act means:
o: A complaint from a private user
A court order or a notice from the appropriate Government
Knowledge from the intermediary's own monitoring
n0a4f0f4d386.x: The Supreme Court read down Section 79 so that 'actual knowledge' means a court order or a notice from the appropriate Government.

nafc2a3eb10c.s: Which of the following I4C components is correctly matched?
o: SAHYOG – AI and Big Data crime analytics
CFCFRMS – Real-time freezing of defrauded funds
nafc2a3eb10c.x: CFCFRMS facilitates real-time freezing of defrauded funds. NCAP does AI and Big Data analytics, SAHYOG issues takedown notices and CyTrain trains police, prosecutors and judges.

n51dea8eda42.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
n51dea8eda42.x: The National Cyber Security Coordinator (NCSC) is associated with the National Security Council Secretariat. NTRO does technical intelligence, I4C is under MHA and NCIIPC protects critical information infrastructure.

nafde8497f55.s:
Consider the following statements about the Budapest Convention on cybercrime:
1. It was adopted under the United Nations.
2. India, Russia and China are not signatories to it.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nafde8497f55.x: Statement 1 is wrong because the Budapest Convention is a Council of Europe convention; statement 2 is correct.

n09a61a10ae9.s: The draft National Cyber Security Strategy was prepared under the coordination of the:
n09a61a10ae9.x: The draft National Cyber Security Strategy was prepared under the National Cyber Security Coordinator.

n5d836176cd1.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: RBI Cyber Security Framework for banks – 2016
RBI Cyber Security Framework for banks – 2024
n5d836176cd1.x: The RBI Cyber Security Framework for banks dates to 2016. SEBI's CSCRF is from 2024 and power-sector CERTs work under the Ministry of Power.

n122a258519e.s: The CCPWC scheme, which provides cyber forensic-cum-training laboratories in 33 States/UTs, has an outlay of:
n122a258519e.x: The CCPWC scheme has an outlay of Rs 132.93 crore and provides cyber forensic-cum-training laboratories in 33 States and UTs.

n222d0f264fc.s: Cyber Shakti is a cyber security training programme for:
n222d0f264fc.x: Cyber Shakti trains women government officials, with 305 participants at the beginner level and 53 at the advanced level.

n4da3e9735f9.s: Which of the following case–proposition pairs is correctly matched?
o: Kharak Singh v State of UP – Privacy recognised as a Fundamental Right
Puttaswamy v Union of India – Early recognition of privacy concerns under Article 21
Gobind v State of MP – Privacy recognised as part of personal liberty
Kharak Singh v State of UP – Informational privacy affirmed
n4da3e9735f9.x: Gobind recognised privacy as part of personal liberty. Kharak Singh is linked with early privacy concerns under Article 21, and Puttaswamy affirmed privacy as a Fundamental Right and informational privacy.

ndde4747d394.s: As understood in India, the Right to Be Forgotten:
o: Applies only to biometric data collected by UIDAI
Limits name-based searches without necessarily erasing judicial records
Automatically cancels the judgment of a court
Prohibits every search involving the person's name
ndde4747d394.x: The Indian understanding of RTBF does not erase judicial records; it can limit name-based searches in appropriate circumstances.

na92bc7bb3b4.s: Under the DPDP Act, transfer of personal data outside India is:
o: Permitted only to countries approved by the RBI
Permitted except to countries restricted by the Central Government
na92bc7bb3b4.x: The DPDP Act follows a blacklist (negative-list) approach: transfers are allowed unless the Central Government restricts particular countries.

n5e3dd185c78.s: The RBI mandate requiring all payment-system data to be stored only in India was issued in:
n5e3dd185c78.x: The RBI's April 2018 mandate required all payment-system data to be stored only in India.

n616f670d12f.s: The Satellite Instructional Television Experiment (1975–76), which reached about 2,400 villages, was conducted with:
n616f670d12f.x: SITE was conducted with NASA using the ATS-6 satellite, reaching about 2,400 villages and nearly 5 million people.

ne27af6c1886.s: Which Indian mission became the first to land near the lunar south pole in 2023?
ne27af6c1886.x: In 2023 Chandrayaan-3 achieved the first landing near the lunar south pole, while Aditya-L1 was sent to the L1 point.

n1bb49af144f.s: Shubhanshu Shukla flew to the International Space Station in June–July 2025 on which mission?
n1bb49af144f.x: Shubhanshu Shukla flew to the ISS on Axiom-4 during June–July 2025.

nap-geography-18-6.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: APSAC – Andhra Pradesh Space Applications Centre
SDSC SHAR – Sriharikota Deep Space Centre
nap-geography-18-6.x: APSAC is the Andhra Pradesh Space Applications Centre. NSTL is the Naval Science & Technological Laboratory, NARL the National Atmospheric Research Laboratory and SDSC SHAR the Satish Dhawan Space Centre.

o: Four solid stages followed by a Vikas liquid stage
Three solid stages and a liquid velocity-trimming module
Two S200 solid strap-ons, an L110 liquid core and a C25 cryogenic stage
HTPB first stage, UH25 second stage and CE-7.5 third stage
na10b814d8db.x: LVM3 uses two S200 solid strap-ons, an L110 liquid core and a fully indigenous C25 cryogenic stage.

o: Four stages in a solid-liquid-solid-liquid sequence
Three solid stages and a liquid Velocity Trimming Module
One solid, one liquid and one cryogenic stage
nb0159d73f7a.x: SSLV has three solid stages and a liquid Velocity Trimming Module that provides precise orbit insertion.

nb44807bb825.s: LVM3 ended India's dependence on foreign launchers for placing satellites of about what mass into GTO?
nb44807bb825.x: LVM3 can place about 4 tonnes into GTO and ended India's dependence on foreign launchers for 4-tonne satellites.

nd27d79b9161.s: Which of the following launch vehicle – first successful payload pairs is correctly matched?
nd27d79b9161.x: PSLV's first successful payload was IRS-P2; SLV-3's was Rohini RS-1 and GSLV's first payload was GSAT-1.

n64cf06c526d.s: Which PSLV variant is correctly matched with its number of strap-on motors?
n64cf06c526d.x: PSLV-QL has four strap-ons; PSLV-CA has zero, PSLV-DL two and PSLV-G six.

ne339d25aa57.s: A second spaceport for SSLV launches is being established at:
ne339d25aa57.x: Orbital launches, including private Agnibaan missions, take place from Sriharikota; a second SSLV spaceport is coming up at Kulasekarapattinam in Tamil Nadu.

n6e0072c783d.s: Cryogenic propulsion, the most efficient propellant category, has an approximate specific impulse of:
n6e0072c783d.x: Cryogenic propulsion has an approximate specific impulse of 450 seconds, the highest among the propellant categories.

n03ef7c28b8d.s: Which of the following pairs relating to air-breathing engines is correctly matched?
o: Ramjet – Speeds of Mach 5–6 and above
n03ef7c28b8d.x: A scramjet has supersonic combustion and is designed for about Mach 5–6 and above; a ramjet has subsonic combustion and operates above Mach 2.

n9e04e08c967.s: APPLE, India's first experimental communication satellite launched in 1981, stands for:
o: Asian Public Platform for Long-distance Education
Aerial Payload and Propulsion Laboratory Experiment
n9e04e08c967.x: APPLE stands for Ariane Passenger PayLoad Experiment, India's first experimental communication satellite (1981).

ne7aec29a898.s: NavIC, a regional system unlike the global GPS, covers India and about how far beyond its borders?
ne7aec29a898.x: NavIC is regional, covering India plus about 1,500 km beyond its borders, whereas GPS is global.

n25612bd605c.s: The IRNSS-1 series satellites were launched from Sriharikota using:
n25612bd605c.x: All IRNSS satellites were launched from Sriharikota, and the IRNSS-1 series used PSLV launch vehicles.

na7680b95e67.s: NVS-01, the first navigation satellite with an indigenous rubidium atomic clock, was launched in May 2023 by:
na7680b95e67.x: NVS-01 was launched in May 2023 on GSLV-F12 and was the first to carry an indigenous rubidium atomic clock; GSLV-F15 flew in January 2025.

nd2dd3bbceb5.s: After the last clock on IRNSS-1F failed on 13 March 2026, how many PNT-capable NavIC satellites remained?
nd2dd3bbceb5.x: Only IRNSS-1B, IRNSS-1I and NVS-01 remained PNT-capable, three satellites, below the four needed for the service.

n82eb64ecfe3.s: Which of the following remote-sensing technique pairs is correctly matched?
o: InSAR – Elevation and canopy height by laser ranging
LiDAR – Ground deformation such as subsidence
NDVI – Vegetation health from red vs near-infrared reflectance
LiDAR – Vegetation health from red vs near-infrared reflectance
n82eb64ecfe3.x: NDVI gauges vegetation health from red vs NIR reflectance; InSAR maps ground deformation and LiDAR uses laser ranging for elevation and canopy height.

n574e1b4b689.s: India's IRS programme, regarded as the world's largest civilian remote-sensing constellation, began in 1988 with:
n574e1b4b689.x: The IRS programme began with IRS-1A in 1988 and is regarded as the largest civilian remote-sensing constellation in the world.

n501adac5357.s: NVS-02, which did not reach its circular orbit, was launched on 29 January 2025 by:
n501adac5357.x: NVS-02 was launched by GSLV-F15 on 29 January 2025, the 100th launch from Sriharikota; a loose pyro connector was blamed for the failure.

ndb8a5683f99.s: Which one of the following is NOT a stage of a standard remote sensing system?
o: Interaction of radiation with the target
ndb8a5683f99.x: Remote sensing gathers information without physical contact, so physical sampling is not a stage; recording, interaction with the target and transmission/reception/processing are.

nd62c303f4b4.s: Which orbit is correctly matched with its typical use?
o: SSPO – Satellite appears fixed over the Equator
nd62c303f4b4.x: LEO extends from about 200 to 2,000 km and is widely used for Earth observation. MEO is used for navigation, GEO for communication and weather, and SSPO for polar imaging.

n53277bfe671.s: Which of the following satellite – launch vehicle pairs is correctly matched?
n53277bfe671.x: INSAT-3DS was launched by GSLV-F14 in 2024. Aditya-L1 flew on PSLV-C57, DS-SAR on PSLV-C56 and NISAR on GSLV-F16.

n4a9706e961f.s: Kalpana-1, India's first exclusive meteorological satellite, was launched in 2002 by:
n4a9706e961f.x: Kalpana-1 was India's first exclusive meteorological satellite, launched by PSLV in 2002.

ne3728b8984e.s: Through the Mars Orbiter Mission, India became ____ to place a spacecraft in Mars orbit.
o: The first country in the world
ne3728b8984e.x: Through Mangalyaan (the Mars Orbiter Mission), India became the first Asian nation to place a spacecraft in Mars orbit.

n40a1ef7bd7e.s: Which Aditya-L1 payload is correctly matched with its function?
o: SoLEXS – Near-ultraviolet imaging of the solar disc
n40a1ef7bd7e.x: HEL1OS performs hard X-ray spectroscopy. SUIT does near-ultraviolet imaging, SoLEXS soft X-ray spectroscopy, and the Magnetometer measures the magnetic field.

n3ff657e30ba.s: Under India's Space Vision 2047, an Indian is to be placed on the Moon by:
n3ff657e30ba.x: The vision envisages the Bharatiya Antariksh Station by 2035 and an Indian on the Moon by 2040.

n08c07c7dc77.s: Russia's Soyuz and China's Shenzhou spacecraft both use a three-module configuration consisting of:
n08c07c7dc77.x: Both Soyuz and Shenzhou use a three-module configuration: orbital, descent and service modules.

na1f50a4870b.s: Which of the following countries already had its own crewed space-launch capability before Gaganyaan?
na1f50a4870b.x: Only the USSR/Russia, the USA and China have their own crewed launch capability; Gaganyaan would make India the fourth.

nefcc1afb99d.s: Which ISS module is correctly matched?
nefcc1afb99d.x: Kibo is the Japanese module. Zarya was the first ISS module, Zvezda is Russian and Destiny is the US module.

n95c8c8d0949.s: IADT-01, the first Integrated Air Drop Test, was conducted at:
n95c8c8d0949.x: IADT-01 was conducted at SDSC-SHAR; IADT-02 was associated with April 2026.

n38a1b6d630d.s: Vyommitra, planned to fly on the uncrewed G1 and G2 missions, is:
o: A male humanoid robot for the crewed flight
The parachute recovery system of the Crew Escape System
n38a1b6d630d.x: Vyommitra is an AI-enabled, female-form semi-humanoid robot meant to fly on the uncrewed G1 and G2 missions before the crewed flight.
